answer: The lime kiln stands on the hill, limestone stacked in the shaft. Proof of lime-burner via quicklime tally — a load the lime-burner slakes only after 21 loads hold their slake without one staying raw at the core, each slaked by the lime-burner himself. terrace loads the stone and fires the kiln for three days. thread draws the burnt lime out and slakes it in the pit. pearl sieves the slaked lime and bags it fine. Twenty-one loads must hold their slake without one staying raw at the core, and the next still stays raw where the fire ran short.
